question: Which of the following state government signed a pact with Cerestra Managers Pvt. Ltd. to set up the Special Education Region in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Gujarat government** and **Cerestra Managers Private Limited** entered into a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** to establish the **Gujarat-Special Education Region (G-SER)** at the **Dholera Special Investment Region.**
 
• The **G-SER **will be built as a** 1,000-acre education hub** with room for expansion** to 5,000 acres.**
 
• This will also feature **student housing and athletic facilities.**
 
• The** state's economic growth **will be **accelerate**d by investment in the G-SER project, which will also lead to** job possibilities.**
 
• **Dholera SIR** is a **greenfield industrial city** being developed around **100 km from Ahmedabad** along the **Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor. **
 
• Dholera is the **first greenfield industrial city **to be built to** support Industry 4.0.**
